🔑 Password generator guide

With Sorola's password generator you can create strong, random passwords directly in your browser. The tool works entirely offline — nothing is sent to the server.

1. Adjust password settings

You can customize the password to be created with the following settings:

  • Length: Select the password length. At least 16 characters is recommended.
  • Uppercase letters (A–Z): Add uppercase letters to the password.
  • Lowercase letters (a–z): Add lowercase letters to the password.
  • Numbers (0–9): Add numbers to the password.
  • Special characters: Add special characters (e.g. !@#$%) salasanaan.

Vinkki: Use all character groups together to create the strongest possible password.

2. Generate a password

  1. Press Copy to clipboard to use the result. Luo salasana -painiketta.
  2. A new random password appears in the result field.
  3. Press Copy to clipboard to use the result. Kopioi to copy the password to the clipboard.
  4. You can create a new password at any time by pressing the button again.

3. Save the password securely

The generated password is not stored anywhere — copy it immediately and save it in a secure password manager such as Bitwarden or Vaultwarden.

  • Do not store passwords in the browser memory, text files, or cloud services unencrypted.
  • Use a different password on every site.
  • Keep the master password only in your own memory.

Privacy

The password generator runs entirely locally in your browser. Generated passwords are never sent to or stored on the server.
